# SACSCOC Standards Index

This index provides quick access to all SACSCOC Standards organized by Section. **Core Requirements** are highlighted for easy identification.

::: {.callout-important}
## Core Requirements
Standards marked with **[CR]** are Core Requirements — the most fundamental standards that require the strongest evidence.
:::

## Filtering Standards

Use the table below to find specific standards. Core Requirements are marked in the "Core" column.

```{=html}
<style>
.core-yes {
  background-color: #fff3cd;
  font-weight: bold;
}
table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
}
th, td {
  border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
  padding: 0.5rem;
  text-align: left;
}
th {
  background-color: #003366;
  color: white;
}
tr:nth-child(even) {
  background-color: #f8f9fa;
}
</style>
```
